consequence.statement: A new metric is available; the evidence describes no operational impact on existing setups.

original.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds a new metric, cilium_identity_cache_timer_duration.

decision.reason: [ev-8a664283f86e] lists `cilium_identity_cache_timer_duration` only under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics". The surrounding section items [ev-1a97b17bde3d] and [ev-1b1b9343e346] are other added metrics, and none of these items says anything fails, changes or must be done. A newly added metric has no operational consequence, so kind none (informational) with low severity is supported.
